title: DLA event (Contract 1, schema_version 1)
description: One recorded browser activity period, written by the Chrome/Edge extension (the only collector). Human-readable version: event-schema.md. JSON Schema cannot check that duration_seconds equals end minus start, or that end is not before start, or that the host of url matches domain: the code that writes events must guarantee all three.

id.description: Unique id. A UUID is recommended.

duration_seconds.description: end minus start, in whole seconds.

source.description: Always the browser extension: it is the only collector.

platform.description: The service the page belongs to. unknown for any other website.

domain.description: Website domain only, lowercase, no scheme, path, query or port.

url.description: Sanitized URL: scheme, domain and path, nothing else. The query string and the fragment are always removed. Long random-looking path segments and known sensitive patterns (reset or login tokens, session ids, email or account ids) are replaced with *. The extension does this cleaning before anything is sent on. Stored only on the PC and never synced. The two 'not' checks below are a last-line safety net, not the cleaning itself.

anyOf.description: A path segment of 32 or more id-like characters is not allowed: it must have been replaced with *.
An email address is not allowed anywhere in the path.

title.description: Tab title, only when permitted. null (or masked) otherwise.

activity_type.description: What kind of page the period was spent on. Time-only kinds (a feed, a home page, a search) are never counted as content items.

content_count.description: 1 when this period is where the user moved to a NEW content item (a Reel, a video, a Short, a post opened on its own address) on a platform whose items can be told apart reliably, else 0. Never invented for feeds. Items watched = SUM(content_count).

session_id.description: The recording session this event belongs to. The extension writes null; the local program stamps the id of the current session when it accepts the event.

media_title.description: Optional, added by the local program when the Windows media controls match this page: the title shown there.

playback.description: Optional, from the same match: playing or paused.

media_app.description: Optional, from the same match: the browser that was playing it.

category.description: Label from the on-device AI. null until labelled.

uncertain.description: true when low confidence made the label fall back to Other.

allOf.description: Not labelled yet: no confidence, no label source, not uncertain.
A model label always has a confidence.
Uncertain means the model was unsure and the label fell back to Other.

utcTime.description: ISO 8601 in UTC with a trailing Z, whole seconds, for example 2026-10-27T05:15:00Z.
